name: admitted_to_top_class_institute
label: Admitted to an institute on the Top Class list, for a listed course

question.en: Have you got admission to an institute on the Top Class list?
question.hi: क्या आपको टॉप क्लास सूची के किसी संस्थान में दाखिला मिला है?

name: admitted_via_management_quota
label: Admitted through a management quota at a private institute

question.en: Was your admission through a management quota?
question.hi: क्या आपका दाखिला मैनेजमेंट कोटे से हुआ है?

name: aicte_technical_first_year
label: In the first year of a technical degree at an AICTE-approved institution, or the second year by lateral entry

question.en: Are you in the first year of a technical degree (such as B.Tech) at an AICTE-approved college, or the second year by lateral entry?
question.hi: क्या आप AICTE से मान्यता प्राप्त कॉलेज में तकनीकी डिग्री (जैसे B.Tech) के पहले साल में हैं, या लेटरल एंट्री से दूसरे साल में?

name: bachelors_marks_percent
label: Percentage in Bachelor's degree

question.en: What percentage did you get in your Bachelor's degree?
question.hi: स्नातक (बैचलर) डिग्री में आपके कितने प्रतिशत अंक आए?

name: class_12_top_20_percent
label: Above the 80th percentile of Class XII passes in their stream and board

question.en: In Class XII, were you in the top 20% of students who passed in your stream on your board?
question.hi: क्या कक्षा 12 में आप अपने बोर्ड और स्ट्रीम के पास हुए छात्रों में शीर्ष 20% में थे?

name: current_mota_award
label: Ministry of Tribal Affairs scholarship currently held

question.en: Do you already get a scholarship from the Ministry of Tribal Affairs?
question.hi: क्या आपको पहले से जनजातीय कार्य मंत्रालय की कोई छात्रवृत्ति मिल रही है?

name: date_of_birth
label: Date of birth

question.en: What is your date of birth?
question.hi: आपकी जन्म तिथि क्या है?

name: education_level
label: Course being studied, or applied for, this academic year

question.en: What are you studying this year, or applying to study?
question.hi: इस साल आप क्या पढ़ रहे हैं, या किस पढ़ाई के लिए आवेदन कर रहे हैं?

name: family_income
label: Annual family income (INR)
description: Gross income from all sources of both parents, or of the living parent. For a married Student, the spouse's income is added. Income of siblings or other relatives is not counted.

question.en: What is your family's total income in a year?
question.hi: आपके परिवार की सालाना कुल आय कितनी है?

help.en: Add up your parents' income from all sources. If you are married, add your spouse's income. Don't count brothers, sisters or other relatives.
help.hi: माता-पिता की सभी स्रोतों से आय जोड़ें। अगर आप विवाहित हैं, तो जीवनसाथी की आय भी जोड़ें। भाई-बहन या अन्य रिश्तेदारों की आय न जोड़ें।

name: gender
label: Gender

question.en: What is your gender?
question.hi: आपका लिंग क्या है?

name: has_aadhaar_seeded_bank_account
label: Has a bank account in a scheduled bank, linked with Aadhaar and mobile number

question.en: Do you have a bank account linked to your Aadhaar and mobile number?
question.hi: क्या आपका बैंक खाता आपके आधार और मोबाइल नंबर से जुड़ा है?

name: has_overseas_admission_offer
label: Has an offer of admission from a university abroad

question.en: Do you have an offer of admission from a university abroad?
question.hi: क्या आपके पास विदेश के किसी विश्वविद्यालय से दाखिले का प्रस्ताव है?

name: holds_other_scholarship
label: Currently receives any other scholarship, fellowship or stipend

question.en: Do you get any other scholarship, fellowship or stipend right now?
question.hi: क्या अभी आपको कोई और छात्रवृत्ति, फेलोशिप या स्टाइपेंड मिल रहा है?

name: institution_eligible_for_fellowship
label: University is UGC 2(f)/12(B), a UGC-funded deemed university, government-funded, or an Institute of National Importance

question.en: Is your university UGC-recognised (2(f) or 12(B)), government-funded, or an Institute of National Importance?
question.hi: क्या आपका विश्वविद्यालय UGC से मान्यता प्राप्त (2(f) या 12(B)), सरकारी अनुदान प्राप्त, या राष्ट्रीय महत्व का संस्थान है?

name: institution_recognised
label: School or institution is government-run or government-recognised

question.en: Is your school or college run or recognised by the government?
question.hi: क्या आपका स्कूल या कॉलेज सरकारी है या सरकार से मान्यता प्राप्त है?

help.en: Your school or college can tell you. Recognised schools have a U-DISE code; colleges have an AISHE code.
help.hi: आपका स्कूल या कॉलेज यह बता सकता है। मान्यता प्राप्त स्कूलों का U-DISE कोड होता है; कॉलेजों का AISHE कोड होता है।

name: is_orphan_supported_by_guardian
label: Orphan supported by a guardian

question.en: Have you lost both parents, and does a guardian support you?
question.hi: क्या आपके माता-पिता दोनों नहीं हैं, और कोई अभिभावक आपकी देखभाल करते हैं?

name: is_scheduled_tribe
label: Belongs to a Scheduled Tribe of their domicile state
description: The Student's tribe is notified as a Scheduled Tribe for the state or union territory they are domiciled in.

question.en: Do you belong to a Scheduled Tribe (ST) of your state?
question.hi: क्या आप अपने राज्य की अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) से हैं?

name: joined_within_two_years_of_class_12
label: Joined the degree course within two years of passing Class XII

question.en: Did you join your degree within two years of passing Class XII?
question.hi: क्या आपने कक्षा 12 पास करने के दो साल के भीतर डिग्री में दाखिला लिया?

name: masters_marks_percent
label: Percentage in Master's degree

question.en: What percentage did you get in your Master's degree?
question.hi: स्नातकोत्तर (मास्टर्स) डिग्री में आपके कितने प्रतिशत अंक आए?

name: net_jrf_qualified
label: Qualified UGC NET or Joint CSIR-UGC NET

question.en: Have you qualified UGC NET or Joint CSIR-UGC NET?
question.hi: क्या आपने UGC NET या संयुक्त CSIR-UGC NET पास किया है?

name: overseas_admission_in_qs_top_1000
label: That university is in the QS World University Rankings top 1,000

question.en: Is that university in the top 1,000 of the QS World University Rankings?
question.hi: क्या वह विश्वविद्यालय QS वर्ल्ड यूनिवर्सिटी रैंकिंग के शीर्ष 1,000 में है?

name: previously_received_nos
label: Has already received the National Overseas Scholarship before

question.en: Have you received the National Overseas Scholarship before?
question.hi: क्या आपको पहले कभी राष्ट्रीय प्रवासी छात्रवृत्ति मिली है?

name: repeating_stage_in_other_subject
label: Studying again at a level already passed, in a different subject (e.g. B.Com after B.A.)

question.en: Are you studying again at a level you have already passed, in a different subject? For example, B.Com after B.A.
question.hi: क्या आप वही स्तर दोबारा किसी दूसरे विषय में पढ़ रहे हैं, जो आप पहले पास कर चुके हैं? जैसे B.A. के बाद B.Com.

name: school_government_aided_or_local_body
label: School is a government, government-aided or local body school (not a Kendriya Vidyalaya, Navodaya, residential or private school)

question.en: Is your school a government, government-aided or local body school? (Not a Kendriya Vidyalaya, Navodaya, residential or private school.)
question.hi: क्या आपका स्कूल सरकारी, सरकारी सहायता प्राप्त या स्थानीय निकाय का है? (केंद्रीय विद्यालय, नवोदय, आवासीय या निजी स्कूल नहीं।)

name: selected_in_nmms_exam
label: Selected in the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship exam at Class VIII

question.en: Were you selected in the NMMS scholarship exam in Class VIII?
question.hi: क्या कक्षा 8 में NMMS छात्रवृत्ति परीक्षा में आपका चयन हुआ था?

name: sibling_received_nos
label: A brother or sister has already received the National Overseas Scholarship

question.en: Has your brother or sister already received the National Overseas Scholarship?
question.hi: क्या आपके भाई या बहन को पहले से राष्ट्रीय प्रवासी छात्रवृत्ति मिल चुकी है?

name: studies_abroad
label: The course is at an institution outside India

question.en: Is your course outside India?
question.hi: क्या आपका कोर्स भारत के बाहर है?

name: studies_by_distance
label: Studying by correspondence or distance learning

question.en: Are you studying by correspondence or distance learning?
question.hi: क्या आप पत्राचार या दूरस्थ शिक्षा से पढ़ रहे हैं?
